scope: Actual planet-transitions.js executed with controllable Web Animations promises, computed styles, cancellation and preference mocks. Visual smoothness and browser rendering require separate QA.

checks.name: Departure holds both layers at zero opacity until incoming frames are ready
Superseding a transition samples its live pose and cannot clear the newer animation
Rapid leave-enter-leave replacement finishes idle with no opacity or transform residue
Explicit cancellation during either phase settles pending callers and restores the layout
System reduced-motion preference uses 90 ms opacity fades with no displacement or delay
